method: Reviewer visually inspected six sheets containing actual unanswered/completed desktop content crops and full narrow screenshots, one pair for each anchor. The report preserves full original screenshots. Each delivered frame was also verified byte-identical to its corresponding raw frame.

cases.active: Correct two rows/two columns, parentheses, ordered integer values, signed glyphs, and requested subscript. Blank empty; solution initially closed. No highlighted cell, convention reminder, intermediate value, or visible key. No clipped matrix or stray TeX at either width.
cases.completed: Correct green integer response, expanded solution with the correct index-to-row/column explanation, and final equation agreeing with the independent answer and key. Narrow solution wraps legibly with no horizontal clipping.
